D: Woody goes after Forky, a spork turned toy, and finds Bo Peep at a travelling carnival.
P: Serve the snacks when the toys sneak into the carnival.
S: Cocktail franks in a cornmeal buttermilk batter, fried
Cocktail franks dipped in a cornmeal batter, fried at 180C until golden, with mustard and tomato sauce.
Corn, cherry tomato, cucumber and avocado with lime, in little cups
Little cups of chopped salad of corn, tomato, cucumber and avocado with lime, each with a spork to eat it.
Ducky and Bunny's cinnamon kettle corn
Ducky and Bunny stuck on the carnival prize wall

Old-school carnival kettle corn popped with sugar and salt in one pot, dusted with cinnamon and served warm in red and white striped bags. Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a large lidded pot over medium-high heat with 3 test kernels. When they pop, add 100g popcorn kernels and 60g caster sugar and cover. Shake the pot constantly as it pops so the sugar doesn't burn. When the popping slows to a few seconds apart, tip straight into a big bowl. Toss with 1 tsp fine salt and 1 tsp cinnamon while hot, then split into paper bags.
M: Crisp chips under hot gravy and shredded barbecue chicken
Thick-cut chips piled with shredded chicken and melty cheese, drowned in hot gravy, Canadian style.
Second Chance Antiques chicken pot pie
the antique store where Gabby Gabby waits

Chicken pot pie with leek and mushroom in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside. Cook 1 sliced leek and 200g sliced mushrooms in the same pan for 6 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 350ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken and chopped thyme and season. Spoon into a pie dish, lay 1 sheet puff pastry over, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
W: Looping swirls of fried batter, golden and crisp
Batter piped in swirls into hot oil, fried golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with strawberries.
K: Frozen strawberries, lemon juice and syrup blended with ice

Strawberries, lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ice into a thick slushie, poured into big cups with a straw and a strawberry on the rim. Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend 400g frozen strawberries with the juice of 4 lemons, the syrup, 250ml cold water and 3 cups ice until thick and slushy. Taste and add more syrup if it's too sharp. Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws and a fresh strawberry on each rim.

s.note: Cocktail franks in a cornmeal buttermilk batter, fried
s.how: Whisk 100g cornmeal, 100g flour, a teaspoon of baking powder and 250ml buttermilk to a thick batter. Pat 24 cocktail franks dry, push a skewer into each, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

s.note: Corn, cherry tomato, cucumber and avocado with lime, in little cups
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber and diced avocado with lime juice and salt. Spoon into little cups and stick a spork in each one. Whatever happens, do not throw the sporks in the bin.

m.note: Crisp chips under hot gravy and shredded barbecue chicken
m.how: Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Heat 500ml beef gravy until bubbling. Pile the chips into 4 bowls with 400g shredded barbecue chicken, scatter over 200g torn fresh mozzarella and pour the hot gravy over so the cheese goes melty.

w.note: Looping swirls of fried batter, golden and crisp
w.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and a spoon of sugar into a smooth batter. Pipe in looping swirls into 180C oil and fry until golden on both sides. Drain, dust thickly with icing sugar and serve warm with sliced strawberries.
